name: influenza-sego2022
title: Influenza infection & immune response (Sego 2022 reproduction)
lead:
A native viva-cpm reproduction of Sego et al. 2022's cellularized influenza
model, built up increment-by-increment (a 10-increment capability ladder,
see how_to_read) from a bare epithelial sheet to the full multiscale
composite at 1 mm^2 paper scale. The CC3D source (ViralInfectionVTM) is the
authoritative parameter/spec reference, cross-checked against the paper's
own tables; Increment 0 establishes that authority and records where the
two disagree, before any engine code exists.

at_a_glance.role: Increment 0: establishes the cited parameter authority, provenance docs, and digitized figure targets; documents open source-vs-paper discrepancies. No simulation.
Increment 1: validates the confluent epithelial-sheet substrate (geometry + 1mm^2 throughput) as a process-bigraph composite. Substrate only — no biology reproduction claim.

Increment 2: validates the virus field (diffusion/decay) + stochastic H->I infection MECHANISM (local spread, population conserved) over the Increment-1 sheet. Mechanism only — no resistance/IFN/immune cells yet, and no Figs 3B/5/7 reproduction claim (still PENDING, Increment 9).

how_to_read:
Read this top-down as a capability ladder, not a finished result:

1. INCREMENT 0 (this scaffold) — spec authority & targets, no engine code.
   Acquire the CC3D source, transcribe Tables 1-4 into a cited params.yaml,
   digitize Figs 3B/5/7 into acceptance bands, record source-vs-paper
   discrepancies. Study: parameter-provenance (documentation only).
2. INCREMENTS 1-8 — one capability + one study + one paper target each,
   validated at reduced (0.3 mm) scale: epithelial sheet, virus field +
   infection, IFN + resistance, death/recovery, chemokine/IL-10 fields,
   macrophage response, NK/CD8+ cytotoxic killing, global ODE coupling.
3. INCREMENT 9 — the capstone: full composite at 1 mm^2 paper scale, 50
   replicas, evaluated against the Increment-0 acceptance bands for Figs
   3B (time series vs ODE), 5 (viral-load sweep, lethal threshold), and 7
   (infection-fraction sweep). This is the "reproducibility achieved"
   deliverable — not yet reached.

Full ladder detail: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-18-influenza-sego2022-reproduction-design.md §5.

glossary.definition: The CompuCell3D supplementary source package for Sego et al. 2022 — the authoritative, source-literal parameter reference for this investigation (as opposed to the paper's printed prose tables, which it occasionally disagrees with).

A place where the CC3D source's literal parameter/behavior differs from the paper's printed table or text. Eight are recorded in docs/cc3d-reference/sego2022-parameters.md §7 and are treated as open items, not resolved.
A per-cell state variable modulating virus release and infected-cell death, driven by local type-I IFN exposure.
The Price (2015)-derived whole-organ immune ODE model that Sego 2022 couples bidirectionally to the spatial CPM patch via scaling factors eta/theta.
A digitized value/lo/hi target range per observable, read by eye from a paper figure (Figs 3B/5/7), used as the pass/fail criterion for the Increment 9 capstone reproduction.

biological_story:
Sego et al. 2022 built a cellularized, multiscale model of local influenza
infection: a 2-D epithelial sheet (Cellular Potts) is infected by a
diffusing virus field, mounts a type-I interferon response that confers
per-cell resistance, and recruits macrophages, NK cells and CD8+ T cells via
chemokine gradients to clear infected cells — all coupled bidirectionally to
a global ODE compartment (Price 2015) that scales the spatial patch to a
physiological lung-epithelium population. It is a rich, independently
published, source-available target for testing whether a from-scratch CPM
engine (viva-cpm) can reach genuine quantitative reproduction of a
real spatial-immunology model, not just a qualitative phenomenon.

The investigation treats the paper's own CompuCell3D supplementary source
(ViralInfectionVTM) as the ground-truth spec, not just the paper's printed
tables — because the source is what actually produced the published
figures, and the two disagree in eight places (neighbor order, two
immune-adhesion entries, lattice-size defaults, the initial-viral-load
sweep encoding, a simplified death-rate term, an asymmetric resistance
usage, and a qualitative-vs-numeric label mismatch on macrophage
chemotaxis). Recording these discrepancies up front, before any engine code
exists, is the point of Increment 0: later increments build on a stated,
auditable authority rather than an implicit blend of "whichever value
looked right."

Capability accrues on a 10-increment ladder: epithelial sheet at scale,
virus field + infection, IFN + resistance, epithelial death/recovery,
chemokine + IL-10 fields, macrophage response, NK/CD8+ cytotoxic response,
the global ODE coupling, and finally the full capstone reproduction against
Figs 3B, 5, and 7 at paper scale with 50 replicas.
question:
Can viva-cpm's native Cellular Potts engine reproduce, to quantitative figure
match, the cellularized multiscale influenza-infection and immune-response
model of Sego et al. 2022 — built on CompuCell3D's ViralInfectionVTM — at
paper scale (Figs 3B, 5, 7)?
hypothesis:
A CPM composite that reproduces the paper's cell types (epithelial,
macrophage, NK, CD8+ T), diffusible fields (virus, type-I IFN, chemokine,
IL-10), per-cell resistance/state transitions, and coupling to the global
immune ODE compartment — parameterized from the CC3D source
(ViralInfectionVTM) as ground truth, cross-checked against the paper's own
tables — will land within the paper's reported acceptance bands for
infected/uninfected/dead epithelial counts and immune-cell trajectories
across the initial-viral-load and initial-infection-fraction scenario
sweeps.

executive.what_is_this:
A ground-up native reproduction of a published cellularized multiscale
infection model (Sego, Mochan, Ermentrout & Glazier 2022, J. Theor. Biol.
532:110918), used as a rigor exercise for viva-cpm's CPM engine: can it
reach quantitative figure match against a real, independently-published
spatial immunology model, using the authors' own CompuCell3D source as
ground truth rather than just the paper's prose? The investigation is
structured as a 10-increment capability ladder (Increment 0 spec/targets,
1-8 individual mechanisms at reduced scale, 9 the full capstone
reproduction) so reproducibility accrues cumulatively and each step is
independently reviewable.
executive.verdict:
Increments 0-2 of 10 landed; reproduction fidelity NOT yet assessed. The
parameter/spec authority is established (pbg_cpm_studies/influenza/params.yaml,
cited to the CC3D source and the paper's Tables 1-4) and figure-target
acceptance bands are digitized for Figs 3B, 5, 7 (Increment 0). The
confluent epithelial-sheet substrate holds stable geometry and steps fast
enough at scale (Increment 1). The virus field diffuses/decays and a
seeded lesion spreads LOCALLY via a stochastic H->I transition, with
population conserved (Increment 2, mechanism-only — no resistance/IFN,
death/recovery, or immune cells yet). Eight source-vs-paper discrepancies
remain recorded, not resolved. No Figs 3B/5/7 reproduction claim is made
— that verdict stays PENDING until Increment 9 (the capstone).
executive.verdict_detail:
Member study parameter-provenance (Design phase, documentation-only)
establishes the parameter authority: it cites params.yaml, the two
provenance docs (docs/cc3d-reference/sego2022-source-notes.md and
sego2022-parameters.md), and the digitized figure targets
(pbg_cpm_studies/influenza/targets/{fig3b,fig5,fig7}.json). It records,
not resolves, the 8 source-vs-paper discrepancies in
sego2022-parameters.md §7 (e.g. neighbor order 3 vs the expected 2,
Infected-Macrophage adhesion 20 vs the paper's collapsed 10,
NKcell-CD8Tcell adhesion 25 vs the paper's collapsed 10). Member study
epithelial-sheet-baseline (Increment 1) validates the bare confluent
sheet substrate (geometry + 1mm^2 throughput) as a process-bigraph
composite — substrate only, no biology. Member study
virus-field-infection (Increment 2) validates the virus field +
stochastic infection MECHANISM (measured: n_I grows 9->16 over 60
updates from a seeded lesion; spread is spatially LOCAL by a discriminating
null-baseline test — new infections land ~0.61x as far from prior-infected
cells as a uniform-random null (actual 15.0 vs random 24.6 sites), and a
shuffled-field non-local control fails at ~1.13x — population conserved;
null control confirms no spontaneous infection).
No reproduction verdict against Figs 3B/5/7 exists yet — that begins at
Increment 9 (the capstone).

decisions_needed.question: Should any of the 8 source-vs-paper discrepancies (sego2022-parameters.md §7) be resolved toward the paper's stated values instead of the source-literal ones before Increment 1 locks in params.yaml as ground truth?
decisions_needed.context:
params.yaml currently follows the CONTROLLER RULING to prefer the
CC3D source literally (it is what actually produced the paper's
results) over the paper's prose tables where they disagree. This is
defensible but is a modeling choice, not a settled fact, and should
be revisited once Increment 1+ studies can show whether either choice
changes reproduction quality.

scientific_argument.main_claim:
Target claim for the investigation (not yet demonstrated): a native
viva-cpm CPM composite, parameterized from the CC3D ViralInfectionVTM
source, reproduces Sego et al. 2022's spatial influenza-infection and
immune-response dynamics within the paper's reported acceptance bands
(Figs 3B, 5, 7) at paper scale.
caveats: No simulation evidence exists yet — Increment 0 is spec/provenance/targets only. evidence_for/evidence_against are intentionally empty rather than fabricated.

The parameter authority (params.yaml) makes an explicit, recorded choice to follow the CC3D source literally over the paper's prose in 8 places (sego2022-parameters.md §7); these are open items, not settled.
Figure targets (Figs 3B/5/7) are hand-digitized from log-scale panels by eye and are approximate acceptance bands, not extracted data.

studies.name: epithelial-sheet-baseline
studies.title: Increment 1: confluent epithelial sheet (substrate only)
studies.question:
Does the CPM engine hold a confluent, source-literal-adhesion epithelial
sheet stable (no gaps, no vanished cells) at 1 mm^2 paper scale, and does
it step fast enough (Rust engine, `step_parallel`) for the eventual
2-week/~20160-MCS capstone run to be computationally feasible?

followup_study_proposals.title: Increment 2: virus field + infection
followup_study_proposals.motivation: Add the diffusible virus field and per-cell infection state on top of this validated substrate.

followup_study_proposals.title: Increment 3: IFN + per-cell resistance
followup_study_proposals.motivation: Layer the type-I IFN response and resistance state variable that modulates infected-cell death.

evidence.observed: mean cell volume ~25 sites, none vanished after 50-step relaxation on the 900-cell confluent 0.3mm tiling

findings.statement:
The confluent epithelial-only sheet (source-literal adhesion H-H=5.0,
H-medium=25.0, target volume 25 sites) is mechanically stable under
CPM relaxation at 0.3mm scale — an engineered geometric result (target
volume matched by construction), not an emergent biological finding.

evidence.observed: 406.47-421.95 MCS/s measured across 4 runs at 1mm^2 (500x500 lattice, 10000 cells), vs 200.0 MCS/s perf-gate floor

findings.statement:
The Rust CPM engine's `step_parallel` throughput at full 1mm^2 scale
is ~2x the perf-gate floor (and ~200x the brief's original 2.0 MCS/s
minimum), so the ~20160-step capstone run remains computationally
tractable — a performance-engineering result, not a biology finding.

studies.claim:
The confluent epithelial-only sheet is geometrically stable (mean cell
volume ~25 sites, none vanished) and the Rust CPM engine steps the full
1mm^2 lattice at ~406-422 MCS/s, far above the throughput needed to make
the eventual 2-week capstone run computationally tractable. This is a
substrate-readiness claim, not a biological-reproduction claim.

biological_validation.basis: This increment has no biology to validate against (no virus, no infection, no immune response) — it is a substrate/perf gate only. Do NOT read PENDING as a passing or failing reproduction verdict; no reproduction claim is made until Increment 9 (the capstone), which evaluates against Figs 3B/5/7.

regression_compatibility.basis: Geometry and throughput reproduce Task 1.1-1.3's measured results exactly (same spec builder, same perf test).

explanatory_gain.basis: No mechanism is being compared to an alternative explanation at this increment; deferred to later increments where dynamics exist.

derived.insight:
The confluent epithelial-only sheet (source-literal adhesion H-H=5.0,
H-medium=25.0, target volume 25 sites) is mechanically stable under
CPM relaxation at 0.3mm scale — an engineered geometric result (target
volume matched by construction), not an emergent biological finding.

studies.name: virus-field-infection
studies.title: Increment 2: virus field diffusion/decay + stochastic local infection spread
studies.question:
Layered on the validated Increment-1 confluent sheet: does a diffusing,
decaying extracellular virus field (source-cited D/decay, target
diffusion length 5 cell diameters = 25 sites) and a stochastic,
virus-driven H -> I infection transition produce LOCAL lesion spread
(new infections cluster near existing infected cells, not uniformly
across the sheet) with population conserved?

followup_study_proposals.title: Increment 3: IFN + per-cell resistance
followup_study_proposals.motivation: Add the type-I IFN field and per-cell resistance state variable that will gate (reduce) the infection transition validated here.

evidence.from_test: Seeded lesion spreads over time (population conserved)
evidence.observed: n_I 9 -> 16, n_H 891 -> 884 over 60 updates (0.3mm sheet, init_infected_frac=0.01, seed=17); n_H + n_I constant every update

findings.statement:
The virus field + stochastic H -> I transition together produce a
growing, population-conserving lesion over 60 updates from a small
seeded start — the base infection mechanism (with resist=0, no IFN
gating) behaves as specified.

evidence.from_test: New infections land closer to prior infection than random chance (locality)
evidence.observed: 7 new-infection events; actual_mean distance-to-nearest-prior-infected-cell 15.0 sites vs a uniform-random null_mean of 24.6 sites (ratio ~0.61, seed 17; ~0.58-0.67 across seeds/step counts, threshold <0.75); a shuffled-virus-field non-local control of the same run gives ratio ~1.13 and correctly fails; first new infection at update 21, 5.0 sites

findings.statement:
New infections land significantly closer to already-infected cells
than uniform-random placement would predict (~0.61x the chance
distance, discriminated against a per-update population-mean null
baseline, not a loose absolute radius) — spatial locality emerges from
the field's own diffusion length (25 sites) without any explicit
"infect-my-neighbor" rule in the transition itself, which only reads
local field concentration. A shuffled-field non-local control
correctly fails the same test (ratio ~1.13), confirming the locality
claim is genuinely earned rather than an artifact of a bound too loose
to discriminate.

evidence.from_test: No seed, no initial virus -> no infection (null control)
evidence.observed: n_I stays 0, new_infection_dists empty every update, for the whole 60-update run with init_infected_frac=0.0

findings.statement:
With no initial lesion and no virus source, nothing infects — the
transition does not spontaneously activate, confirming the field is
the sole driver of new infections in this mechanism.

studies.claim:
The extracellular virus field diffuses and decays (source-cited
parameters), and a seeded lesion of InfectedReleasing cells spreads via a
stochastic, virus-driven H -> I transition to nearby Healthy cells
(locally, within a few diffusion lengths), with total cell population
conserved every update. This is a MECHANISM-validation claim (the field
and the transition behave sensibly together), not a claim that any of
Sego et al. 2022's quantitative figure targets (Figs 3B/5/7) are met —
that reproduction verdict remains PENDING until Increment 9 (the
capstone).

biological_validation.basis: This increment validates the MECHANISM (field diffusion/decay, local stochastic infection spread, population conservation) with a single seeded run, not a quantitative reproduction against any of Figs 3B/5/7. No resistance/IFN, death/recovery, or immune-cell dynamics exist yet. Do NOT read PENDING as a passing or failing reproduction verdict — no reproduction claim is made until Increment 9.

regression_compatibility.basis: Reproduces Task 2.3's measured integration-test results exactly (same driver, same seed).

explanatory_gain.basis: No alternative mechanism is being compared at this increment; deferred to later increments / the capstone where a reproduction comparison against the paper's figures becomes meaningful.

derived.insight:
The virus field + stochastic H -> I transition together produce a
growing, population-conserving lesion over 60 updates from a small
seeded start — the base infection mechanism (with resist=0, no IFN
gating) behaves as specified.

key_metrics.label: No seed, no initial virus -> no infection (null control)
